notes:
New: Swap A and B, per game. Open a game, go to Controllers, and turn on Swap A and B if that game reads the button under your thumb as the wrong one. It applies to that game only and leaves your other games alone. X and Y swap with it, since it is the same rotation. This is separate from Nintendo Swap in Settings, which only changes which button confirms in the SCCM menus and never affects a game.

Also fixed: native ports (the Ports tab) now use the controller mappings you set up in the wizard. Until now they ignored them and fell back to whatever the system guessed, so a non-standard or third-party pad could behave oddly in a port. If a port felt wrong on your controller, try it again after this update.
